name: Sole Survivor
description: Winning the game is the ultimate goal. 'Sole Survivor' is the most vital category and is worth the most points.

name: Final Three
description: Reaching the Final Three shows strategic success, endurance, and jury management.
recapTemplate: {name} made it to the Final Three!

name: Successful Fire Making
description: The fire making challenge directly determines the Final Three contestants in modern Survivor. The winner will prove that they have what it takes to perform under immense pressure.

name: Make the Merge
description: Making the merge is a critical milestone; it demonstrates strong social gameplay and tribal alliances up to that point.

name: Individual Immunity
description: Winning individual immunity shows physical prowess and helps players avoid elimination in key moments.

name: Tribal Immunity
description: Tribal immunity prevents contestants from facing elimination. It’s critical pre-merge but less impactful after. Tribal Immunity points will only be awarded to the tribe that gets 1st place in a tribal immunity challenge. Contestants are eligible for these points even if they sit out of the challenge to make numbers even.
recapTemplate: {name}'s tribe won the tribal immunity challenge!
recapTemplatePlural: {name}'s tribe won the tribal immunity challenge {count} times!

name: Hidden Immunity Idol
description: Obtaining a hidden immunity idol can change the course of the game, offering massive strategic value. These points will be awarded to a contestant who finds and controls a hidden immunity idol. A contestant will still earn these points even if they never play the idol, or if the idol is played for another player.

name: Shot in the Dark: SAFE
description: Contestants facing certain elimination may play their Shot in the Dark for a 1 in 6 shot at safety. If the result is SAFE, they have defied the odds to gain immunity and survive another day, not to mention it't just about the coolest thing someone can do in this game.
recapTemplate: {name} played their Shot in the Dark... successfully!!
recapTemplatePlural: {name} played their shot in the dark {count} times.

name: Reward Challenge
description: Going on a reward provides resources, morale boosts, and key bonding opportunities, though it is not directly related to survival. Winning a reward challenge doesn't necessarily mean points here. *A contestant must go on the reward in order to score these points!*

name: Journey
description: Going on a Journey requires a high level of either bravery or bad luck, but it also leads to opportunity and advantages.

name: Advantage
description: Finding or using an advantage can help, but it doesn't always guarantee safety or success. Advantages will be awarded similar to hidden immunity idols. Points will be given to the player(s) who obtain and control the advantage. Beware advantages DO count for this category.

name: Vote Someone Out
description: Being on the right side of the vote is crucial for any contestant's case for Sole Survivor. And it certainly beats being on the wrong side of the vote. This is awarded when a contestant correctly votes for the contestant who goes home at a given tribal council.
recapTemplatePlural: {name} voted correctly at Tribal Council {count} times!

name: Survive an Episode
description: Progressing through episodes gradually earns points, though it’s less impactful than major game milestones.

name: Confessional
description: These make up a huge majority of the show... why am I not scoring them?? Confessionals give us insight into a contestant's brilliance or insanity. The more entertaining a contestant is, the more confessionals they get! Plus they need to stick around to keep getting them :)

name: Shot in the Dark: NOT SAFE
description: Contestants facing certain elimination may play their Shot in the Dark for a 1 in 6 shot at safety. If the result is NOT SAFE, their attempt failed and they remain in danger of elimination.
recapTemplate: {name} played their Shot in the Dark... unsuccessfully.
recapTemplatePlural: {name} played their shot in the dark {count} times.

name: Lost or Stolen Vote
description: Contestants can lose their vote through a Journey or beware advantage, or have it blocked or stolen by another contestant. They lose their power to send somebody else home and become a target themselves. Castaways will NOT lose points if they lose their vote and have it restored before their next Tribal Council AND the end of the episode. Castaways who are exiled are already penalized and will NOT lose points for not being able to vote.

name: Exiled
description: Getting sent to Exile Island (or something similar) removes a contestant from the game and leaves them without resources or shelter. It's the worst thing that can happen aside from getting voted out. Contestants will be docked points for each episode where they are sent to or in exile and don't get out. Contestants will still lose points if they go to and come back from exile in the same episode.

name: Voted Out
description: Getting voted out means your game is over and you did not win. ...Unless? 👀 No, but for real, if a contestant gets voted out they lose 75 points.
